saints.name: St. Paul of the Cross
saints.title: Priest and Founder
saints.shortBlurb: A mystic of the Passion who founded the Passionists to keep the sufferings of Christ before the world…
biography: Paul Francis Danei was born at Ovada in northern Italy in 1694. After a period of intense prayer and inspiration he composed a rule for a new congregation devoted to preaching and meditating on the Passion of Christ, and in time founded the Congregation of the Passion, whose members add a fourth vow to keep alive the memory of the sufferings of the Lord.

He spent nearly fifty years as a missionary preacher through the towns and countryside of Italy, renowned for the power of his sermons and for his gifts in prayer. He died in Rome in 1775 and was canonized by Pope Pius IX in 1867.
saints.knownFor: Founding the Passionists and preaching the Passion.

sources.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), “St. Paul of the Cross”
